shared_elements: low-relief carving on pale weathered stone
horizontal band/line dividing the surface into registers
figures shown in profile facing sideways
a row of repeated similar forms across the upper area
quadruped or seated figure with limbs shown in outline
rectangular/rounded slab format with carving confined to one face
justification: Both are pale stone slabs carved in shallow relief and organised into stacked registers separated by a plain horizontal band, with profile figures marching across each register — that register-and-band scheme is the most specific correspondence. The subject matter and handling differ sharply: A shows bold, rounded, heavily modelled animal forms on an irregular architectural pillar, while B is a portable rounded-top plaque covered with fine, thin, linear incisions of clothed human figures around furniture and offerings.
